source: Eligibility questions in the style of the Dutch applicable-rules question trees (docs/international-practices.md). Each answer switches incentive toggles; defaults stay at maximum value until the user answers.

questions.text: Do you have capital gains you could invest in this project?
How long do you plan to own the building after it is finished?
questions.rule: OZ exclusion needs 10 or more years; bonus depreciation applies to hold scenarios

questions.text: Will you buy building materials through an Enterprise Zone certificate before purchase?
affects: Enterprise Zone materials sales tax exemption

questions.text: Does the building include ground-floor commercial space?
Will you sell the units to owner-occupants?
